transcript.en: Hello, English learners and welcome back to another great lesson with EnglishPod.
transcript.zh: 大家好，英语学习者们，欢迎回到 EnglishPod 的又一节精彩课程。

transcript.en: And today we're bringing you a great intermediate lesson with some really useful vocabulary.
transcript.zh: 今天我们为大家带来一节很棒的中级课程，有一些非常实用的词汇。

transcript.en: Some vocabulary you can use to describe your job.
transcript.zh: 一些可以用来描述你工作的词汇。

transcript.en: This is a really common situation when someone asks you what you do and you have to tell them.
transcript.zh: 这是一个非常常见的场景——当别人问你做什么工作时，你得告诉他们。

transcript.en: So today's lesson is all about that.
transcript.zh: 所以今天的课全是关于这个的。

transcript.en: So before we jump into our dialogue, let's start with our vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 在进入对话之前，先来看词汇预览。

transcript.en: We have two simple phrases today that you'll hear in our dialogue for our vocabulary preview.
transcript.zh: 今天的词汇预览有两个简单的短语，你会在对话中听到。

transcript.en: So the VP of a company is?
And the next word is Fortune 500 company.
transcript.zh: 下一个词是 Fortune 500 company（财富500强公司）。

transcript.en: Well, Fortune magazine ranks the 500 biggest companies in the US.
transcript.zh: 嗯，《财富》杂志对美国最大的500家公司进行排名。

transcript.en: So a Fortune 500 company basically is?
transcript.zh: 所以 Fortune 500 公司基本上就是？

transcript.en: One of the 500 biggest companies in the US.
transcript.zh: 美国500家最大的公司之一。

transcript.en: Well, with those words, it sounds like we're going to be talking to some important people today.
transcript.zh: 嗯，从这些词来看，我们今天好像要和一些重要人物对话了。

transcript.en: We are going to be talking to some important people.
transcript.zh: 我们确实要和一些重要人物对话。

transcript.en: So let's listen to our dialogue for the first time.
transcript.zh: 所以来听第一遍对话吧。

transcript.en: Now it's going to be a little bit fast, but you don't have to worry about it.
transcript.zh: 语速会有点快，但不用担心。

transcript.en: Because we'll come back and explain all of the important vocabulary.
transcript.zh: 因为我们会回来解释所有重要词汇。

transcript.en: She's always going on about him at the office.
transcript.zh: 她在办公室老是不停地讲他。

transcript.en: I'd like you to meet my boyfriend, Greg.
transcript.zh: 我想介绍你们认识我男朋友，格雷格。

transcript.en: He's the VP of quality and safety for a top Fortune 500 food company.
transcript.zh: 他是一家顶级财富500强食品公司负责质量和安全的副总裁。

transcript.en: Caroline talks about you all the time.
I guess he must be pretty busy at work.
transcript.zh: 我猜他工作一定很忙吧。

transcript.en: VP position is not easy, you know.
transcript.zh: 你知道，副总裁的位置不好当的。

transcript.en: I implement policies and procedures nationwide in various departments, as well as trained junior managers in FDA and EPA regulations.
transcript.zh: 我在全国各地的各个部门实施政策和流程，还要培训初级经理了解 FDA 和 EPA 的法规。

transcript.en: I also have to oversee daily operations of our quality control for the entire East Coast.
transcript.zh: 我还要监督整个东海岸质量控制的日常运营。

transcript.en: That alone means I have 1,500 employees under me.
transcript.zh: 光这一项就意味着我手下有1500名员工。

transcript.en: What do you do for a living?
Great music for our dialogue again, huh?
transcript.zh: 我们对话的音乐又很棒，对吧？

transcript.en: Yeah, Top Gun is one of my all-time favorite movies.
transcript.zh: 是啊，《壮志凌云》是我一直以来最喜欢的电影之一。

transcript.en: And top gun pilot, what a cool profession.
transcript.zh: 壮志凌云飞行员，多酷的职业啊。

transcript.en: Much cooler than being like the VP.
Anyway, this guy was a bit of a jerk, don't you think?
transcript.zh: 不管怎样，这家伙有点讨厌，你不觉得吗？

transcript.en: Yeah, you can tell a little bit of the sarcastic tone he had in his voice.
transcript.zh: 是的，你能听出他语气中带有一丝讽刺。

transcript.en: But he did use some interesting phrases and we can talk about those now.
transcript.zh: 但他确实用了一些有趣的短语，我们可以现在讨论。

transcript.en: So let's take a look at language takeaway.
Our first word for language takeaways is implement.
transcript.zh: 语言要点的第一个词是 implement（实施/执行）。

transcript.en: Let's listen to some examples of this word to help us understand its meaning.
transcript.zh: 来听一些例子，帮我们理解这个词的意思。

transcript.en: Our company has to implement this sales strategy.
transcript.zh: 我们公司必须实施这个销售策略。

transcript.en: Sarah will be responsible for implementing the plan.
transcript.zh: 莎拉将负责执行这个计划。

transcript.en: And just in case, to implement means to put into action.
transcript.zh: 以防万一，implement 意思是将……付诸行动。

transcript.en: Our second word for language takeaway, policies.
transcript.zh: 语言要点的第二个词，policies（政策/规定）。

transcript.en: So, policies are basically rules and regulations.
transcript.zh: Policies 基本上就是规章制度。

transcript.en: For a company or an organization.
transcript.zh: 为一家公司或组织制定的。

transcript.en: So, when you oversee operations, it means?
transcript.zh: 当你说 oversee operations，意思是？

transcript.en: Like, you watch it to make sure it's okay.
transcript.zh: 就像你盯着它确保没问题。

transcript.en: This is an excellent word to use when you want to talk about your job responsibilities.
transcript.zh: 当你想谈论你的工作职责时，这是一个非常好的词。

transcript.en: And our last word for language takeaway, it's kind of tricky, so let's listen to how it was used in our dialogue.
transcript.zh: 语言要点的最后一个词有点难，来听听对话中是怎么用的。

transcript.en: That alone means I have 1,500 employees under me.
transcript.zh: 光这一项就意味着我手下有1500名员工。

transcript.en: That alone means I have 1,500 employees under me.
transcript.zh: That alone means I have 1,500 employees under me.

transcript.en: So this guy has 1,500 employees under him, meaning he supervises 1,500 employees.
transcript.zh: 所以这家伙手下有1500名员工，意思是他管理着1500名员工。

transcript.en: He must be a busy man.
How many employees do you have under you, Erica?
transcript.zh: 艾瑞卡，你手下有多少员工？

transcript.en: I guess I'm not a VP right yet, hey?
transcript.zh: 我想我还没当上副总裁呢，对吧？

transcript.en: So, with this in mind, we are ready to listen to our dialogue for a second time, and this time it's going to be slower.
transcript.zh: 所以，了解了这些，我们准备听第二遍对话，这次会慢一些。

transcript.en: She's always going on about him at the office.
transcript.zh: 她在办公室老是不停地讲他。

transcript.en: I'd like you to meet my boyfriend, Greg.
transcript.zh: 我想介绍你们认识我男朋友，格雷格。

transcript.en: He's the VP of quality and safety for a top Fortune 500 food company.
transcript.zh: 他是一家顶级财富500强食品公司负责质量和安全的副总裁。

transcript.en: Caroline talks about you all the time.
I guess he must be pretty busy at work.
transcript.zh: 我猜他工作一定很忙吧。

transcript.en: VP position is not easy, you know.
transcript.zh: 你知道，副总裁的位置不好当的。

transcript.en: I implement policies and procedures nationwide in various departments, as well as trained junior managers in FDA and EPA regulations.
transcript.zh: 我在全国各地的各个部门实施政策和流程，还要培训初级经理了解 FDA 和 EPA 的法规。

transcript.en: I also have to oversee daily operations of our quality control for the entire East Coast.
transcript.zh: 我还要监督整个东海岸质量控制的日常运营。

transcript.en: That alone means I have 1,500 employees under me.
transcript.zh: 光这一项就意味着我手下有1500名员工。

transcript.en: What do you do for a living?
With this, now we can start with our fluency builder for today.
transcript.zh: 接下来我们可以开始今天的流利表达了。

transcript.en: We heard some excellent phrases in this dialogue, some phrases that sound really natural, hey?
transcript.zh: 我们在对话中听到了一些很棒的短语，一些听起来非常自然的短语，对吧？

transcript.en: Yes, especially the first one that we have today is whenever someone talks and talks and talks and just, and continuously talks without stopping, you would say...
transcript.zh: 是的，尤其是今天的第一个——当某人没完没了地不停说话时，你会说……

transcript.en: She's always going on about him at the office.
transcript.zh: 她在办公室老是不停地讲他。

transcript.en: She's always going on about him at the office.
transcript.zh: She's always going on about him at the office.

transcript.en: This is a really natural way of saying keeps talking about.
transcript.zh: 这是表达「不停地说」的一个非常自然的方式。

transcript.en: So we have a few examples of how this phrase works.
transcript.zh: 我们有几个例子来说明这个短语的用法。

transcript.en: My boss is always going on about how we need to save money.
transcript.zh: 我老板老是不停地说我们需要省钱。

transcript.en: Gary is always going on about his kids.
transcript.zh: 加里老是不停地讲他的孩子。

transcript.en: He's always talking about how smart they are.
transcript.zh: 他总在说他们有多聪明。

transcript.en: My mom is always going on about how I should get married.
transcript.zh: 我妈老是不停地说我应该结婚。

transcript.en: Okay, so let's move on to our second phrase for today and this is a great one to use whenever you meet someone for the first time.
transcript.zh: 好的，来看今天的第二个短语，当你第一次见到某人时用这个非常合适。

transcript.en: Or when you start to talk to someone for the first time.
transcript.zh: 或者当你第一次和某人开始交谈时。

transcript.en: So this is a really relaxed and natural way of saying how are you?
transcript.zh: 这是表达「你好吗」的一个非常轻松自然的方式。

transcript.en: So yeah, you can just say, hey, how's it going?
transcript.zh: 所以你可以就说，嘿，how's it going？

transcript.en: Now, our third phrase is the most important one of our dialogue.
transcript.zh: 现在，第三个短语是对话中最重要的一个。

transcript.en: And it's a really common situation.
transcript.zh: 这是一个很常见的场景。

transcript.en: When someone asks you about your job, they might say this.
transcript.zh: 当有人问你的工作时，他们可能会这样说。

transcript.en: Arthur, what do you do for a living?
transcript.zh: 亚瑟，你是做什么工作的？

transcript.en: Arthur, what do you do for a living?
transcript.zh: Arthur, what do you do for a living?

transcript.en: So this is a really great way of asking what work do you do or what is your job?
transcript.zh: 这是询问「你做什么工作」的一个非常好的方式。

transcript.en: I know a lot of students sometimes say, what is your job?
transcript.zh: 我知道很多学生有时会说「what is your job？」

transcript.en: And that is, it's kind of correct, but not really.
transcript.zh: 那某种程度上算对的，但其实不是。

transcript.en: So you can use, what do you do?
transcript.zh: 所以你可以用「what do you do？」

transcript.en: Or what do you do for a living?
transcript.zh: 或者「what do you do for a living？」

transcript.en: That's the way you ask someone what is their job.
transcript.zh: 这才是你问别人工作的正确方式。

transcript.en: And that's how you sound super natural.
transcript.zh: 这样你说起来就超级自然。

transcript.en: So we're ready now to listen to our dialogue a last time.
transcript.zh: 现在我们准备好最后听一遍对话了。

transcript.en: And now you are ready to understand everything.
transcript.zh: 现在你已经能理解全部内容了。

transcript.en: Caroline talks about you all the time.
I guess he must be pretty busy at work.

transcript.zh: 我在全国各地的各个部门实施政策和流程，还要培训初级经理了解 FDA 和 EPA 的法规。

transcript.en: That alone means I have 1,500 employees under me.
transcript.zh: 光这一项就意味着我手下有1500名员工。

transcript.en: What do you do for a living?
Okay so I have a little challenge for our listeners today.
transcript.zh: 好的，今天给听众们一个小挑战。

transcript.en: The first one, who performs the song that you heard and what is the song called?
transcript.zh: 第一个，你听到的歌是谁唱的，歌名是什么？

transcript.en: Okay, I don't know the answer.
So I'm looking forward to seeing what users do.
transcript.zh: 所以我很期待看到用户的答案。

transcript.en: And the second one is, what is the number one company in the Fortune 500?
transcript.zh: 第二个是，财富500强排名第一的公司是哪家？

transcript.en: Oh, I also don't know this answer.
transcript.zh: 哦，我也不知道这个答案。

transcript.en: So I expect to see your answers on the comments page.
transcript.zh: 所以我期待在评论页面看到你们的答案。

transcript.en: But also we want to know about your profession.
transcript.zh: 我们还想知道你的职业。

transcript.en: Tell us what you do and use some of the great phrases you learned today to describe your answer.
transcript.zh: 告诉我们你做什么工作，用一些今天学到的好短语来描述你的答案。

transcript.en: So we hope to see you there but we're out of time now.
transcript.zh: 希望在那里见到你们，但我们现在没时间了。

transcript.en: So we'll see everyone at EnglishPod.com.
transcript.zh: 我们会在 EnglishPod.com 见到大家。

transcript.en: Leave all your questions and of course all the comments.
transcript.zh: 留下你们所有的问题，当然还有评论。

transcript.en: And Marco and I are always around to answer your questions.
transcript.zh: 我和马可一直都在，会回答你们的问题。
